decisions.reason: The net price display plugin serves a steady B2B need close to the core offer and costs little to maintain, but its absence from the website in 2020–2021 means its value is not yet confirmed, so the option stays open for now.

As the lead price comparison tracker it is worth keeping as the one consolidated option, though its absence from the website and the cost of porting it to new shop platform versions raise the risk that it gets pruned.

Four years after launch, with no visible presence since 2019 and overlap with C, the uncertainty has largely resolved against this redundant variant, so its maintenance resources are better spent on core business and new development.
The net price reporting plugin complements A and the firm's analytics services at low cost, so keeping it is still justified even though it lacks visible traction.
